description: Everyone your People Searches found on one platform, one entry per person: their best-scoring result and the search that found them (found_by). Free; it does not run a new search. Search by name, handle, bio, or location with q, filter by contact channels (has), audience, fit score, location, or verification, and sort by score, recent, or audience. People from searches that ended more than 30 days ago are left out.

has.description: Channels every person must have, example: ['email', 'instagram']. 'email' is a public email; the others are a link of that type.

location.description: Text in the location, example: 'united states'.

q.description: Text in the name, handle, bio, or location, example: 'skincare'.

verified.description: Only verified accounts. Only X and TikTok people carry a verified flag.

name: people-profiles
title: List People Found
